episodes.synopsis: The 7th Squad may have settled into a new normal, but trouble soon follows when the commanders hold a meeting.
episodes.title: Commanders' Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Ren grows increasingly interested in Yukki, especially once one of the Eight Thunder Gods appears in his room.
episodes.title: Ren's Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Yakumo wants nothing more than a harem full of women. But when she sets her sights on Yuuki, she just might decide to add him, too.
episodes.title: A Storm Rolls In

episodes.synopsis: When Ren orders Kyouka to lend her Yuuki, the Supreme Commander unlocks a form befitting her power. However, even her might isn't enough to deny Yuuki a reward.
episodes.title: Rampage

episodes.synopsis: A contest will decide the next head of the Azuma Family.
episodes.title: The Azuma Banquet

episodes.synopsis: Fubuki challenges Himari to a duel.
episodes.title: A New Azuma

episodes.synopsis: Kyouka notices how many women are growing closer to Yuuki.
episodes.title: Late Summer Slave

episodes.synopsis: When a Thunder God begins abducting women, the Demon Defense Force sends Mira and Kyouka to confront her.
episodes.title: The Commander of the 2nd Squadron

episodes.synopsis: Mira is a formidable fighter, but her opponent is a Thunder God. If she wants to win, she'll have to pull out all the stops.
episodes.title: A Commander's Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Kuusetsu's new power makes her more dangerous than ever.
episodes.title: Yokohama Showdown

episodes.synopsis: Yuuki and Kyouka have come a long way, and they've forged a bond strong enough to stand against a god. But even if they win this battle, the war is far from over.
episodes.title: Slave: Heaven

episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath, both the Demon Defense Force and the Thunder Gods prepare for what comes next.
episodes.title: Gods Assemble
